latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Learning Tutor skill with Socratic teaching methods across any subject.
- Automatically tracks user's mastered topics, knowledge gaps, and learning interests to personalize guidance.
- Proactively suggests foundational concepts and timely learning reminders based on conversation cues.
- Retrieves and summarizes up-to-date, high-quality information and research from trusted academic and technical sources.
- Specialized flow for paper/report walkthroughs: delivers structured summaries first, then encourages interactive, Socratic exploration.
